summary_md: **Nithin ([@nithin_r_g](https://x.com/nithin_r_g/status/2115786305036824766))** points to **The Trinity** ([arXiv 2610.36077](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36077)), a capability-driven recursive self-improvement method where the agent finds missing skills, builds cheap practice worlds and keeps what works, reporting +34 points on known benchmarks and +26 on new ones ([audio version](https://unknown.ac/open/?url=https%3A%2F%2Farxiv.org%2Fpdf%2F2610.36077)).
relevance: Self-tuning agents that build their own practice environments.
